raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

On integrated GPUs (DGX Spark / GB10 and similar unified-memory parts) weight loading is dominated by the host-to-device copy itself: both safetensors iterators hand out mmap views, and a copy taken straight from an unmapped file-backed view pays its page faults inside the driver copy. Measured on a DGX Spark with the real shards of `nvidia/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct-NVFP4` (1027 tensors, 5.61 GiB), fresh process per variant, page cache dropped before each:

| source of the copy | total | per tensor |
|---|---|---|
| mmap view (current iterators) | 34.3 s | 33 ms |
| mmap view, page cache pre-warmed | 33.6 s | 33 ms |
| `.clone()` of the view | 0.12 s | 0.12 ms |
| view with one byte per page touched first | 0.11 s | 0.11 ms |

The page cache does not matter; the cost is the fault-in during the copy. vLLM hit the same thing (vllm-project/vllm#58726) and fixed it by touching the pages before the copy (vllm-project/vllm#58868). On a smaller unified-memory laptop part the same checkpoint took 1882 s to load.

## Modifications

`_fault_in_mmap_view()` touches one byte per page of each `get_tensor` view before it is yielded, in both `safetensors_weights_iterator` and `buffered_multi_thread_safetensors_weights_iterator`, when the current CUDA device reports `is_integrated`. The pages stay file-backed and reclaimable, so no extra host memory is used; discrete GPUs are unchanged. `--weight-loader-disable-mmap` stays as a user knob (it reads each shard into anonymous memory: 3.99 s here, at +2.6 GB of transient host memory).

Complementary to #46128, which warms the page cache sequentially before the multi-thread loader maps a shard: that removes the 4 KiB-at-a-time read; this removes the fault-in during the copy, which the warm-cache row above shows is a separate cost.

## Accuracy Tests

No numerical change: the same tensors are yielded in the same order. The new unit test (`test/registered/unit/model_loader/test_fault_in_mmap_views.py`) forces the integrated-GPU gate on, checks that every page of a shard's mapping is resident after each yield (`/proc/self/smaps` Rss), and that the tensors are byte-identical; it also checks the helper is a no-op when the gate is off and accepts 0-d, empty, non-contiguous and bf16 tensors. CI has no integrated GPU, so this is the only coverage of the touch path.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

DGX Spark (GB10, CUDA 13), `nvidia/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct-NVFP4`, `--quantization modelopt_fp4 --mem-fraction-static 0.5`, page cache dropped before each run, "Load weight" from the server log:

| | Load weight |
|---|---|
| main | 31.04 s / 30.62 s |
| this PR | **0.94 s** |
| `--weight-loader-disable-mmap` on main | 3.99 s (+2.6 GB host RAM) |

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests as outlined in the [Running Unit Tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#running-unit-tests-adding-to-ci).
- [ ] Update documentation / docstrings / example tutorials as needed.
- [x] Provide throughput / latency benchmark results and accuracy evaluation results as needed.
- [ ] For reviewers: If you haven't made any contributions to this PR and are only assisting with merging the main branch, please remove yourself as a co-author when merging.
- [ ] Please feel free to join our Slack channel if you need help.

@@ -7,11 +7,13 @@
 import collections
 import concurrent.futures
 import fnmatch
+import functools
 import glob
 import hashlib
 import itertools
 import json
 import logging
+import mmap
 import os
 import re
 import struct
@@ -1143,6 +1145,33 @@ def _drop_file_cache_after_load(path: str) -> None:
             os.close(fd)
 
 
+@functools.lru_cache(maxsize=1)
+def _integrated_gpu() -> bool:
+    """True when the current CUDA device shares host memory (DGX Spark, N1X, Thor)."""
+    try:
+        return torch.cuda.is_available() and bool(
+            torch.cuda.get_device_properties(torch.cuda.current_device()).is_integrated
+        )
+    except Exception:
+        return False
+
+
+def _fault_in_mmap_view(t: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Fault the file-backed pages of a safetensors mmap view in on the CPU.
+
+    On an integrated GPU, a host-to-device copy taken straight from an unmapped
+    mmap view pays its page faults inside the driver copy, which is two orders
+    of magnitude slower than faulting the pages here first (DGX Spark: 33 s vs
+    0.9 s for a 5.6 GiB checkpoint; N1X: 1 882 s). The pages stay file-backed and
+    reclaimable, so this costs no extra host memory. No-op on discrete GPUs.
+    """
+    if _integrated_gpu() and t.device.type == "cpu" and t.is_contiguous() and t.numel():
+        flat = t.reshape(-1).view(torch.uint8)
+        flat[:: mmap.PAGESIZE].sum()
+        flat[-1:].sum()
+    return t
+
+
 def safetensors_weights_iterator(
     hf_weights_files: List[str],
     disable_mmap: bool = False,
@@ -1176,7 +1205,7 @@ def safetensors_weights_iterator(
         else:
             with safetensors.safe_open(st_file, framework="pt", device="cpu") as f:
                 for name in f.keys():
-                    yield name, f.get_tensor(name)
+                    yield name, _fault_in_mmap_view(f.get_tensor(name))
         if drop_cache_after_load:
             _drop_file_cache_after_load(st_file)
     if prefetch_handle is not None:
@@ -1352,7 +1381,7 @@ def _load_file(st_file: str):
                 result = safetensors.torch.load(f.read())
         else:
             with safetensors.safe_open(st_file, framework="pt", device="cpu") as f:
-                result = {k: f.get_tensor(k) for k in f.keys()}
+                result = {k: _fault_in_mmap_view(f.get_tensor(k)) for k in f.keys()}
         return result
 
     # Sliding window: max_workers loading + 1 prefetched.

@@ -0,0 +1,80 @@
+"""The safetensors iterators fault mmap-backed views in on the CPU on integrated GPUs.
+
+CPU-only: the integrated-GPU gate is forced on, so this is the only coverage of
+the touch path (CI has no integrated GPU)."""
+
+import os
+import re
+
+import pytest
+import safetensors.torch
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.model_loader import weight_utils
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=5, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+
+def _mapped_rss_kib(path: str) -> int:
+    """Resident KiB of the file mapping of `path` in this process (from /proc/self/smaps)."""
+    real = os.path.realpath(path)
+    total, current = 0, False
+    with open("/proc/self/smaps") as f:
+        for line in f:
+            if re.match(r"^[0-9a-f]+-[0-9a-f]+ ", line):
+                current = line.rstrip("\n").endswith(" " + real)
+            elif current and line.startswith("Rss:"):
+                total += int(line.split()[1])
+    return total
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def shard(tmp_path):
+    tensors = {
+        f"layer.{i}.weight": torch.arange(
+            i * 1000, i * 1000 + 256 * 1024, dtype=torch.int32
+        ).view(256, 1024)
+        for i in range(4)
+    }
+    p = tmp_path / "model.safetensors"
+    safetensors.torch.save_file(tensors, str(p))
+    return str(p), tensors
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("iterator", ["single", "multi"])
+def test_views_are_faulted_in_on_integrated_gpus(monkeypatch, shard, iterator):
+    path, expected = shard
+    monkeypatch.setattr(weight_utils, "_integrated_gpu", lambda: True)
+    if iterator == "single":
+        it = weight_utils.safetensors_weights_iterator([path])
+    else:
+        it = weight_utils.buffered_multi_thread_safetensors_weights_iterator(
+            [path], max_workers=1
+        )
+    seen = {}
+    with safetensors.safe_open(path, framework="pt", device="cpu") as f:
+        for name, t in it:
+            seen[name] = t
+            # every page of the view is resident while the mapping is alive
+            assert _mapped_rss_kib(path) >= t.numel() * t.element_size() // 1024 - 8
+    assert set(seen) == set(expected)
+    for name, t in seen.items():
+        assert torch.equal(t, expected[name])
+
+
+def test_touch_is_a_no_op_off_integrated_gpus(monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(weight_utils, "_integrated_gpu", lambda: False)
+    t = torch.zeros(3, 5)
+    assert weight_utils._fault_in_mmap_view(t) is t
+
+
+def test_touch_accepts_edge_cases(monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(weight_utils, "_integrated_gpu", lambda: True)
+    for t in (
+        torch.zeros(()),
+        torch.zeros(0),
+        torch.zeros(5, 7)[:, 1:3],
+        torch.zeros(9, dtype=torch.bfloat16),
+    ):
+        assert weight_utils._fault_in_mmap_view(t) is t
